sources.title: Georgia lookout towers (GA tower list with coordinates, elevation and GFC number)

notes_for_editor: Evidence is one list line and the list's naming note; the story is about 120 words. Two Facebook posts by the Douglas County GA History group (found by search; body text not retrievable by fetch_text or WebFetch) appear to describe a GFC tower near Central Church Road and Kings Highway, and a 'Fire Beacon' tower. A search snippet gives the first as 105 feet high. Neither is cited: their text could not be read and nothing ties them to this record. Worth checking by hand. Andy Mountain (GA170, also Douglas County) is a different tower on the same list. Not on the NHLR Georgia list or the FFLOS Georgia listing checked. The Douglas County History Trail page has no tower mention.
